content.short: RatsDAO is the first Decentralized Autonomous Organization on the Cardano Blockchain that purchases blue chip NFTs.
content.description:
RatsDAO is democratizing access to blue chip NFTs by joining forces and capital for acquisition and then employ financial innovations that allow us to accrue rewards for the benefit of DAO members.

RatsDAO experienced tremendous growth and became a game changer in the NFT community. We achieved a treasury valued at more than 1,200,000 ADA with a collection of NFTs: including, the Berry Cardinal, 33 SpaceBudz, 52 DEADPXLs, 4 Clay Budz, 81 Clay Mates by Clay Nation, 16 Clay Nation x GC, 10 Yummi Universe Narus, 24 plots on Artifct Moon, 16 Eggvolution, an estate in Pavia, more than 100,000 ADA and an assortment of DeFi Tokens. This collection will only grow from here. Our RatsDAO NFT is in the top 20 sales of all time in the secondary market with over 1.7M ADA, and we finished building our RatsDAO Staking Platform for RatsDAO members to earn $RAT token.

We started a completely new project on Cardano, meaning that all the tools we need to develop our project are not currently at our disposal. That is why we are partnering with ADAO and working with developers to create new governance tools that have not existed on Cardano until now. We are promoting the growth of a new Cardano DAO ecosystem. Our most important goal is building Layer 0: the community.
